title: FlowDoc Documentation Authority Cleanup
summary: Centralize FlowDoc-wide documentation authority in Project Control, then classify and clean repository-local Markdown without losing source evidence or repo-owned contracts.
expectedOutput: Project Control commit 98bcec99d905c95feb765c1d630bda2f225bd998 adds the Project Control documentation authority policy and cleanup Work foundation that requires Authority Boundary wording before product-repository Markdown cleanup starts. Editor commit 04daeeaaac04317508b5cf8e93de61249255d477 retires the old node-authoring roadmap plan/spec pair from docs/superpowers and guards surviving docs/superpowers files with temporary Authority Boundary wording. Project Control records a repository Markdown inventory snapshot showing Project Control 92, Core 347, Backend 40, Editor 57 tracked Markdown files at exact source commits, with product repositories read-only and evidence target evidence-flowdoc-repository-markdown-inventory-2026-08-31. Backend commit c24f7f000a8b8e9a181434dd95d7611afa026a75 retires the one backend service hardening plan from docs/superpowers, preserves its retained readiness context in docs/BACKEND_SERVICE_READINESS_BOUNDARY.md, and Backend docs/superpowers is now empty. Core commit 6c1b53796802772467bf715b83764ac1ef613e52 retires all four Core docs/superpowers Text Block and Live Draft plan/spec files, retargets active Core references to Project Control Text Block and Live Draft syntheses, and Core docs/superpowers is now absent. Editor commit 4927a0022dc8170b8cb386ede0129a69508a1d29 retires the remaining three Editor docs/superpowers Overview/History and WYSIWYG files, moves the WYSIWYG boundary guard into the Editor code contract, and Editor docs/superpowers is now absent. Project Control commit be0729767ba3e86a828e4f133edf17380ab77fbe completes the agent-role rewrite by adding Documentation Authority For Roles to docs/domains/flowdoc-role-catalog.md. Project Control commit 89d68b571ff4f815a99a5e53efc09252258c08e1 retires all 21 Project Control docs/superpowers Markdown files, moves the active Project Control design to docs/domains/flowdoc-project-control-architecture-and-gui-design-2026-08-12.md, records retained value and discard rationale in docs/domains/project-control-superpowers-retirement-2026-09-01.md, and Project Control docs/superpowers is now absent. Project Control records Core repo-local Markdown classification at Core commit 6c1b53796802772467bf715b83764ac1ef613e52 showing Core 348 tracked Markdown files, 343 visible Markdown files, five hidden .superpowers/sdd Markdown files, docs/superpowers absent, four Authority/Project Control signal matches, and 344 tracked Core Markdown files without Authority Boundary or Project Control signal. It sets hidden .superpowers/sdd and Core project-state/status/roadmap/planning docs as the next cleanup lanes while Core remains read-only.
riskSummary: Project Control docs/superpowers cleanup is recorded by evidence-project-control-superpowers-docs-retired-2026-09-01; Project Control docs/superpowers is now absent on the cleanup commit, and historical source paths remain valid only when commit-pinned. Core repo-local Markdown classification is recorded by evidence-core-repository-markdown-classification-2026-09-01; hidden Core .superpowers/sdd Markdown has five tracked execution artifacts that rg visible scans miss, and 344 tracked Core Markdown files without Authority Boundary or Project Control signal require review before being treated as current authority. Repo-local Markdown is not deleted wholesale by this cleanup Work, and Project Control, Core, Backend, and Editor still contain many Markdown files that need separate classification, source preservation, and repository-owned cleanup verification before removal. Final agent-role rewrite is recorded by evidence-flowdoc-agent-role-documentation-authority-rewrite-2026-09-01; the role catalog now blocks product-repository docs/superpowers plans or specs for FlowDoc-wide truth and requires broad plans to start in Project Control Work, Phase, Checklist, and Evidence targets.
